parts.name: Sphere
parts.Basic_description: This is the spherical part of the globe made of plastic, representing the Earth’s surface with continents and oceans printed on it.
parts.Functional_description: It serves as the main display surface for geographical information and can rotate around its axis for viewing different regions.
parts.Movement_description: It can rotate freely around its axis when mounted on the base.

parts.name: Base Body
parts.Basic_description: This is the base body of the globe, typically made of plastic, providing support and stability to the spherical part.
parts.Functional_description: It holds the sphere in place and allows it to rotate smoothly while keeping the globe upright.
parts.Movement_description: It remains stationary and does not move during normal use.
